title: cotula alpina
intro: Cotula alpina, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Cotula alpina include its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cotula alpina include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
